name: Smolder
title: The Fiery Fledgling

passive.name: Dragon Practice

description.normalized: Dragon Practice: Hitting enemy champions with abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grant a stack of Dragon Practice, which improves Smolder's basic abilities. Dragon Practice Empowering Effects: - Super Scorcher Breath: Deals an additional 30% magic damage and gains new effects at 25, 100 and 175 stacks. - Achooo!: Explosions deal an additional 55% magic damage. - Flap, Flap, Flap: Each hit deals an additional 12% magic damage and gains an extra bolt ever 65 stacks.

passive.rawParsedText:
Dragon Practice: Hitting enemy champions with abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grant a stack of Dragon Practice, which improves Smolder's basic abilities.

Dragon Practice Empowering Effects:

- Super Scorcher Breath: Deals an additional 30% magic damage and gains new effects at 25, 100 and 175 stacks.

- Achooo!: Explosions deal an additional 55% magic damage.

- Flap, Flap, Flap: Each hit deals an additional 12% magic damage and gains an extra bolt ever 65 stacks.

q.name: Super Scorcher Breath

description.normalized: Belches flame, dealing 45 / 80 / 115 / 150 (+110% bonus AD) physical damage and 40% magical damage. If the target dies, 15 Mana is refunded, once per cast. Dragon Practice Empowering Effects: -25 stacks: Damages all enemies nearby the target. -100 stacks: Sends 2 explosions beyond the target that deal 50% of this ability's damage. -175 stacks: Burns the target, dealing 0% (+0.025% bonus AD) of their max Health as true damage over 3 seconds. Enemy champions that drop below 6.5% of their max HP while burning are killed instantly. This ability's damage scales with Critical Rate, increased by 7.5% damage per 10% Crit Rate (max 75%).

w.name: Achooo!

description.normalized: Lets out a flaming sneeze, dealing 65 / 85 / 105 / 125 (+60% bonus AD) physical damage and slowing by 35% for 1.5 seconds. Sneeze Blast: Hitting champions causes an explosion, dealing 10 / 35 / 60 / 85 (+55% bonus AD +80% AP) physical damage and 55% magic damage in an area. Each consecutive explosion does 75% damage. Smolder gains 1 Dragon Practice stack per champion hit. Deals 130% damage against minions and monsters.

e.name: Flap, Flap, Flap

description.normalized: Gains 75% Movement Speed and ignores terrain for 1.25 seconds. Boom!: While flying, automatically locks on to the lowest Health enemy in range and bombards them 5 times. Each hit deals 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 (+30% AD) physical damage and 12% magic damage. Dragon Vision: Gains expanded vision while flying. Prioritizes champions for bombarding.

r.name: MMOOOMMMM!

description.normalized: Smolder's mom breathes fire from above, dealing 200 / 300 / 400 (+110% bonus AD +100% AP) physical damage to enemies in range. Enemies in the center take 300 / 450 / 600 (+165% bonus AD +150% AP) physical damage and are slowed by 40% for 2 seconds. Smolder heals for 100 / 135 / 170 (+50% bonus AD +75% AP) Health if he is hit. Deals 50% damage against minions and monsters.
